views.description: Directed flow overlay: every edge has a predicate and a payload. Laid out left-to-right by flow depth, so the payment path reads in order.

stages.title: Design a Product
stages.purpose: Define and govern canonical product specifications, pricing models, feature policies and bundling rules before any customer or terminal interaction.

stages.title: Customer / Product Onboarding
stages.purpose: Convert prospect intent into configured merchant records, provision terminal hardware and SDKs, and distribute customer configuration intent into runtime domains.

stages.title: Taking Payments and Getting Paid
stages.purpose: Ingest payments across touchpoints, clear and authorise against schemes, project ledger accounting, calculate settlements, execute funds movement, recover fees, and feed analytics.

views.source_notes: Derived from the structured text feed the whiteboard's owner authored for this purpose (https://tyropaymentsltd.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ARCH/pages/2382233611/Payment+target+state+WIP+AI+feed). The whiteboard body itself is not readable through the Atlassian connector -- only its metadata and a ~260-character indexed text extract -- so the feed page is the machine-readable source and the whiteboard is the human original. Both are WIP.

nodes.title: Payments Product Domain
nodes.purpose: Own Tyro’s merchant acquiring product as a coherent offering across channels , by defining the product-level rules, entitlements, and lifecycle that sit above merchant configuration and below commercial pricing. It provides the authoritative “product view” for acquiring—what capabilities exist, how they’re packaged, and which features apply to which customer cohort—without becoming a system-of-record for transactions or balances.
nodes.authority: Canonical product catalog, versioned product/feature policies
nodes.responsibility: Canonical product catalog, versioned product/feature policies

nodes.title: Product Quoting & Pricing
nodes.scope_note: Called tyro-wide: prices all products, though acquiring MSF / interchange-plus pricing is its most complex case.
nodes.purpose: Define, govern, and apply Tyro’s commercial revenue logic across products and channels—so pricing, fees, revenue share, and commissions are consistent, versioned, auditable, and reusable across Payments, Banking, Lending, Financial Management, and partner-led propositions. It is authoritative for commercial policy and calculation, not for scheme fees, ledger entries, invoicing, or settlement.
nodes.authority: Canonical commercial pricing and revenue policies
nodes.responsibility: Canonical commercial pricing and revenue policies

nodes.title: Product Bundling & Eligibility
nodes.purpose: Define and orchestrate how Tyro sells and manages multi-product bundles , including eligibility checks, bundle composition rules, and cross-product activation coordination. This prevents bundling logic being scattered across product domains and sales tools.
nodes.authority: Canonical bundling rules and eligibility criteria
nodes.responsibility: Canonical bundling rules and eligibility criteria

nodes.title: Digital Channels & Experience Domain
nodes.purpose: This domain owns the experience layer and channel behaviour, not the underlying product truth. It should be thin, API-driven, and orchestration-focused to support platformisation and reuse.

nodes.title: Customer Service & Support Domain
nodes.purpose: This domain is the system of record for support work and outcomes, not for product configuration truth, transaction truth, or customer identity truth.

nodes.title: User & Identity Domain
nodes.purpose: Provide Tyro’s authoritative capability for managing system identities and enforcing access through authentication and authorisation controls across customer, partner, and staff channels. This domain is authoritative for system accounts and access control metadata, not for real-world party relationships or customer master identity.

nodes.title: Customer & Product Onboarding
nodes.purpose: Orchestrate the end-to-end process from prospect → application → assessment → approval → product activation across one or more products . Owns the application workflow state machine and sequencing, while delegating decisions and record creation to authoritative domains.

nodes.title: Customer Domain
nodes.purpose: Provide Tyro’s authoritative capability for mastering real-world parties and their relationships so Tyro can maintain a single system of record for customers across products and services. This domain is authoritative for party identity and relationships, not for authentication credentials, sessions/tokens, or low-level access control policy evaluation.

nodes.title: Payments Customer Configuration Domain
nodes.purpose: Maintain the authoritative configuration for how a specific customer is set up to accept payments across Tyro’s acquiring channels . This domain is the “control plane” for acquiring: it defines the merchant’s operational setup that downstream runtime and processing domains must follow. This domain is merchant-specific configuration truth. It does not run checkout sessions, does not own transaction truth, does not calculate payouts, and does not own commercial pricing rules.
nodes.authority: Merchant acquiring setup (MIDs), pricing assignments, acceptance parameters
nodes.responsibility: Merchant acquiring setup (MIDs), pricing assignments, acceptance parameters

nodes.title: Terminal Fleet & Device Management Domain
nodes.purpose: This domain ensures terminals are secure, up to date, correctly configured, and observable — without owning financial transaction truth.
nodes.authority: Device runtime control, config provisioning, fleet management
nodes.responsibility: Device runtime control, config provisioning, fleet management

nodes.title: Payments Channels Domain
nodes.purpose: This domain owns checkout/session lifecycle, channel runtime behaviour, device/app channel configuration at runtime, and request shaping/validation. It is the execution layer that bridges merchant configuration and downstream processing. It does not own transaction truth , merchant configuration truth , or settlement logic.

nodes.title: Payments Processing Domain
nodes.purpose: Process acquiring card payments from authorisation to clearing, and maintain the authoritative “transaction truth” required for reliable merchant acquiring operations. It is the system of record for payment transaction lifecycle state and clearing evidence, not for merchant configuration, settlement calculation, disputes workflow, accounting journals, rail transfers, or banking ledgers.

nodes.title: Settlement & Reconciliation Domain
nodes.purpose: Aggregate cleared acquiring transactions, apply fees/adjustments, and produce the authoritative calculation of what Tyro owes each merchant , including settlement batch formation and reconciliation controls. …and to provide reproducible, auditable settlement outcomes suitable for a regulated environment. It is the system of record for merchant settlement calculations, not for executing transfers , not for maintaining the bank ledger , and not for maintaining payments accounting journals/control accounts .
nodes.authority: Settlement intent, settlement calculation, reconciliation controls
nodes.responsibility: Settlement intent, settlement calculation, reconciliation controls

nodes.title: Payments Accounting Domain
nodes.scope_note: Called acquirer-specific: the payments sub-ledger. Distinct from the tyro-wide Accounting Product Domain.
nodes.purpose: This domain is the system of record for operational accounting entries and balances for the Payments product. It consumes authoritative source events from Payments Processing, Settlement & Reconciliation, and Product Quoting & Pricing and produces auditable double-entry accounting representations.

nodes.title: Funds Movement Domain
nodes.scope_note: Called tyro-wide: rail execution (BECS/NPP/RTGS) serves banking payouts and merchant settlement alike, though merchant settlement is its highest-volume caller.
nodes.purpose: This domain is the authoritative source for transfer execution state, not the source of “why” a payment is being made, and not the ledger of balances .
nodes.authority: Payment rail execution, transfer state authority
nodes.responsibility: Payment rail execution, transfer state authority

nodes.title: Billing & Accounts Receivable Domain
nodes.scope_note: Called tyro-wide: bills every Tyro product, though merchant fee recovery in the acquiring flow is a large share of it.
nodes.purpose: Manage what customers owe Tyro by owning the authoritative lifecycle for billing accounts, invoice generation and issuance, and accounts-receivable balances, aging, and collections, kept separate from transaction settlement, the banking ledger, and corporate GL.

nodes.title: Data Analytics & Intelligence Domain
nodes.purpose: Provide Tyro’s technical foundation and operational capability to ingest, transform, store, and serve data as trusted, reusable data products — enabling analytics and cross-domain insights while not owning operational master truth. Operational domains remain authoritative for business invariants.

nodes.title: Cross-domain reports
nodes.authority: Analytical models and aggregated views produced for staff, merchants and regulators
nodes.responsibility: Analytical models and aggregated views produced for staff, merchants and regulators
